identity: Tall lace-up duty boots, a pair, reaching to mid-shin. Each foot's whole outline is the wearer's own foot curve, so the sole and toe always match; only the shaft above the ankle is free-drawn.

regions.note: near boot. Traces the wearer's own foot_outline (the sole/toe/heel corners are its exact points); the last two points raise the ankle-height corners to mid-shin for the shaft.
far boot, mirror of the near one.
